diagnosis: The deterministic pass-A and pass-B payloads had already been built and compared. Windows denied deletion of the duplicate pass-B directory. The cleanup exception was treated as a replay failure even though it occurred after the byte-identical comparison and did not indicate source, formula, C1, C2 or payload corruption.
smallest_lawful_resolution: Retry removal after clearing read-only attributes and bounded delays. If Windows still denies deletion, move only the duplicate pass-B workspace outside the candidate staging tree into compute quarantine with an explicit cleanup receipt, then continue finalisation without changing candidate bytes or authority.
